environment.description: Celery worker on ECS Fargate with identical code. Task role credentials are vended through a custom credential broker sidecar (hashicorp vault agent injector v1.3.1) that rotates the ephemeral STS session tokens every 60 seconds via AssumeRole with a 60-second DurationSeconds parameter. The vault agent template renders credentials to a tmpfs volume at /vault/secrets/aws-creds which the application reads. The STS session policy attached during AssumeRole includes a Condition block requiring aws:ViaAWSService and restricts to ses:SendEmail and sqs:ReceiveMessage only. Additionally, the ECS task has a network configuration with security group sg-0f9e8d7c6b5a that blocks all egress except port 443 to the SES VPC endpoint (vpce-01234abcdef) and the SQS VPC endpoint (vpce-56789ghijkl), and port 6379 to the ElastiCache subnet CIDR 10.0.4.0/24. The task metadata endpoint credential vending is disabled via ECS_DISABLE_TASK_METADATA=true environment variable, forcing credential resolution through the vault-injected file only.

config.security_group: sg-0f9e8d7c6b5a (egress: 443 to vpce-01234abcdef, vpce-56789ghijkl; 6379 to 10.0.4.0/24; deny all other)
